mintAuthority.summary: SAFO tokens are UUPS-upgradeable ERC-20s governed by a per-chain Permission Manager (PM) contract. On Ethereum, the PM's ADMIN group (group 0) is held by a legacy 6-signer multisig (threshold 3) at 0x4eaa52b6. The mint requirement on the Ethereum token is group 0 or group 2; only the multisig currently holds group 0 (group 2 was previously assigned to an EOA that has since been removed). The PM itself is upgradeable but has no separate proxy admin, so upgrades require group 0 approval by this multisig.

controls.evidence: Spiko's token is a UUPS-upgradeable ERC-20 whose privileged functions (including mint/burn) are governed by a central Permission Manager; Spiko, as transfer agent for the SICAV, mints fund shares on KYC-gated subscription at the published NAV.

controls.label: Spiko Permission Manager ADMIN group — Ethereum (6-signer legacy multisig, threshold 3)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25576670, authority() on SAFO ETH token 0xcbade7d9 returned PM 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472. getRequirements on the PM returned the ADMIN group mask for upgradeToAndCall on both the token and PermissionManager; getGroups() resolves this multisig to that ADMIN group. getOwners() returned 6 signers and getThreshold() = 3. The token and PermissionManager have EIP-1967 implementation slots 0xbf5fb9284c9cf2798d5f18a9702af620cd4351be and 0xd3f5f1524e1a472b51374a3ff41b8936eb5b658e respectively, with zero EIP-1967 admin slots, so this group is the UUPS upgrade control.

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25576670: SAFO token authority = PM 0x344278aff. The PM ADMIN group 0 resolves to 0x4eaa52b6, a 6-signer legacy multisig with threshold 3. The PM requires that ADMIN group for upgradeToAndCall on both the token and PermissionManager; both are UUPS proxies with zero EIP-1967 admin slots. Group 2 (previously EOA 0x60a9, now removed via remGroup tx history) remains a separate mint group. Per-chain PM state differs; this verification covers the Ethereum deployment. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: CACEIS independently calculates daily fund NAV and PwC performs four statutory audits per year; the latest holdings data disclosed by Spiko was updated 2026-03-03. The AMF GECO registry matches the exact Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund containing USD share class FR0014015LE1.
